claims.claim: For the selected POST action marked [HttpPost("linked")], the handler assigns order.UserId and order.Updated only inside if (command.LinkUser); when LinkUser is false, that branch leaves both fields untouched.

On the handler path, authentication and a non-null current user ID are required before the order is loaded; after the link conditional, the handler loads that user and calls ResolveEventTypeIdAsync for the payment event type.

If the payment event type ID is present and no matching event-sync entry is found, the handler adds an EventSync with the user ID, email, and event type ID; its parameters include the order UUID and order total formatted as 0.00, and CreatedAt and UpdatedAt are set to DateTime.UtcNow.
After the event-sync checks, the handler awaits SaveChangesAsync on the path that reaches that line, whether or not an event-sync row was added.
